## Task: Single source of truth for default exclude patterns

Repo: C:\Users\graff\WebstormProjects\rule-validator

### Problem

Default exclude globs are duplicated/split across:

- `src/index.ts` — `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` (node_modules, dist, build, tests, fixtures, rules, scripts, …)
- `src/ast-scan.ts` — `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` (`**/__fixtures__/**`, `**/*.test.ts`, …)
- `src/typescript/compiler.ts` — inline `defaultExcludes` (`node_modules/**`, `dist/**`, `build/**`)

### Goal

Create one shared module (e.g. `src/exclude-patterns.ts` or add to an existing small module) that exports composable constants:

Suggested shape (you may refine names):

```ts
export const ALWAYS_EXCLUDE = ["node_modules/**", "**/node_modules/**", "dist/**", "build/**"] as const;
export const TEST_AND_FIXTURE_EXCLUDE = ["**/__fixtures__/**", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.test.tsx", "**/*.test.js", "**/*.test.jsx"] as const;
// plus any regex-scan-only patterns currently in index.ts DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS
export const REGEX_SCAN_DEFAULT_EXCLUDES = [...] as const;
export const AST_SCAN_DEFAULT_EXCLUDES = [...] as const;
```

Wire:

- `index.ts` applyScanDefaults → use shared REGEX (or full) defaults
- `ast-scan.ts` → use shared AST defaults
- `compiler.ts` getFilesMatchingPattern → use ALWAYS_EXCLUDE (or accept that callers pass full list; don't re-hardcode node_modules/dist/build)

Preserve current _effective_ exclude behavior for each entry point (don't accidentally start excluding more/less than before for regex vs AST). Diff carefully against previous arrays.

### Acceptance

1. No duplicated string literals for `node_modules/**` / `dist/**` / `build/**` across those three files
2. `bun test` passes (full suite)
3. `bun typecheck` exits 0
4. No commits

Files changed, how defaults compose, test results
